message: `@({event} ...)` in a form this engine does not honour
description: Discarding the trigger would run the body at every solve point instead of when the event fires. For the analysis-filter form that is sharper still: the filter says "not in this analysis", so dropping it runs the body precisely where the model excluded it, wrong in every analysis and not merely unimplemented.
actions: Write the bare `@({event})`, or an `or` list of bare `initial_step`/`final_step`; both are honoured.
